sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 32005 of 2023

Applicant :- Mahendra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jai Singh Yadav

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1. Heard Sri Jai Singh Yadav, learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant seeking bail in case crime no. 426 of
2019, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., at Police Station-Civil Lines, District Moradabad.

3. As per the prosecution case, an Fir has been registered against 5 persons including the present
applicant; the story is that the instant applicant-Mahendra sold of certain property belonging to the
first informant to co-accused Aqeel Ahmad in 2015 through a registered sale deed.

4.  It is contended on behalf of the applicant that the dispute is essentially civil in nature; he executed the sale deed in the year 2015 regarding property khasra no. 268/2 and that the property held by the complainant's side is khasra no. 268; false allegations have been imputed on him; the applicant has filed the copies of the sale deeds in question; the applicant is in custody since last more than a month and he is having no criminal history.
5. The application for bail is opposed by learned A.G.A., however it is admitted that the applicant is in custody since last more than a month now and it cannot be said with certainty that how long it will take for trial to conclude.
Mahendra vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150155355/
1 6.
I considered the nature of allegation, evidence collected and all other facts and circumstances of the case including explanatory defence offered by the applicant.
In my view, a case for bail is made out.

7. Let applicant-Mahendra be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime Number on his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.

(iii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (a) hearing/framing of charge and (b) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. without exception.
8.
Any violation of above conditions will be treated misuse of bail and learned Court below will be at liberty to pass appropriate order.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 #Vikram/-
